schema.courses.json: course_id (PK, format "DEPT::COURSE_NUMBER"), department (FK->departments), course_number, course_header (generic "NUM - Special Topics" for 599 courses, since the real title varies per offering), current_units, units_changed
schema.reviews.json: review_id (PK), course_id (FK->courses.course_id), professor_id (FK->professors.professor_id, nullable), professor_raw, multi_prof, prof_uncertain, semester, year, units, rec_course, rec_prof, career, career_categories[], useful, comments, topic_title (the specific offering's title; for 599 courses this varies per review, for all other courses it mirrors course_header)

note: No counts or derived aggregates are stored anywhere. course_id is now uniformly "DEPT::COURSE_NUMBER" (decoupled from title text). 599 "Special Topics" courses are consolidated to one course row per course_number; the actual per-offering topic lives on Review.topic_title, not on the course.
